Subject: Tri-band Exec Demo: DST cutover week availability & split-session option

Hi Linnea + Marco —

Thanks again for the quick discovery call yesterday. We had a good sense of the key decision makers: Aurora execs (CEO Marco, CTO Linnea), and the platform team who will want a technical deep-dive.

Given the US/EU/APAC footprint and the EU DST cutover next week (CEST->CEST no change, but US PST will still be shifting in a few weeks), I sketched 3 scheduling options that try to minimize late nights for execs while keeping a single live exec slot:

Option A — single executive slot (30m):
  - 08:30 PDT / 17:30 CEST / 00:30 AEST (next day) — early for APAC execs, ok for EU
Option B — single executive slot (30m) shifted later for APAC: 
  - 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CEST / 03:00 AEST (next day) — better for APAC, late for EU
Option C — split session (preferred):
  - Exec alignment: 30m focused exec brief, run twice (one 08:30 PDT / one 20:00 CEST) — pick one that includes both CEO/CTO; redundant but short
  - Technical deep-dive: separate 60m recorded session during APAC business hours the next day (onsite engineering leads)

I attached a quick slot_matrix.xlsx with availability slots from our side and a one-page MAP (MAP_Aurora_v1.pdf) with suggested stakeholders and outcomes.

Could you share Marco and Linnea’s absolute no-go windows for May 15–18? If split-session makes sense to you, we can prioritize an exec hour that both Marco and Linnea can make and record the deep-dive for the APAC team.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

—Rishi
